authorization: PM Option 2: derive admission from itemised storage calculation, reclaim disposable toolchains, monitor execution; no timeout-only pip run

items.name: base_image_expanded
items.basis: Pinned OCI manifest compressed bytes x estimated expansion factor 2.5; actual expanded size is unmeasured

items.name: installed_dependencies
items.basis: Measured wheel ZIP uncompressed entries x 1.10; 10% allowance for bytecode, venv and installation metadata

items.name: build_cache_transient_duplicate
items.basis: One additional full dependency-layer footprint allowed during build/commit; base layers shared in classic Docker store

items.name: temporary_wheel_files
items.basis: All 55 compressed wheels simultaneously present during pip; --no-cache-dir prevents persistent pip cache

items.name: image_export_push_scratch
items.basis: Larger of measured wheel archives or 65% of installed dependency layer; no docker save/export tar archive

items.name: filesystem_and_evidence_overhead
items.basis: 0.5 GiB estimate for Docker metadata, context and retained logs

items.name: clean_stop_diagnostics_reserve
items.basis: 4 GiB maintained as active low-space stop trigger; not capacity available to the build

cache_policy: pip --no-cache-dir; classic Docker store; builder prune after build; no image archive saved; digest pull reuses local content
limits: Expansion/compression factors and overheads are explicit estimates. Sampled filesystem peak can miss sub-second spikes. This is not a proven storage bound.
